# nico_site_explorer (Resource)

Site Explorer discovers BMC endpoints on a Site and tracks their exploration state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_site_explorer" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  action                         = "action-value"
  target                         = "target-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Site Explorer endpoint action to trigger.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site whose explored endpoints are targeted.
- `target` (String) Endpoint set to target.

### Optional

- `endpoint_ids` (List of String) BMC IP addresses to target when target is EndpointIds.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) BMC IP address used as the explored endpoint ID.
- `exploration_requested` (Boolean) Whether the endpoint will be explored in the next Site Explorer run.
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `last_ipmitool_bmc_reset` (String) Last BMC IPMI tool reset time.
- `last_redfish_bmc_reset` (String) Last BMC Redfish reset time.
- `last_redfish_powercycle` (String) Last BMC Redfish power-cycle time.
- `last_redfish_reboot` (String) Last BMC Redfish reboot time.
- `pause_remediation` (Boolean) When true, Site Explorer will not take remediation actions for Redfish errors.
- `preingestion_state` (String) Current preingestion state for the endpoint.
- `report` (Attributes) Data gathered about an endpoint during site exploration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report))
- `report_version` (String) Version of the exploration report; increases when the report is updated.

Read-Only:

- `chassis` (Attributes List) chassis attribute. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--chassis))

- `last_exploration_error` (String) Last exploration error serialized as JSON, when present.
- `last_exploration_error_schema` (Attributes) Structured exploration error for operator tooling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--last_exploration_error_schema))

- `machine_id` (String) Machine ID derived for the endpoint when available.
